payload.text: The English translation of Table 5-1 (Appendix B) departs materially from the governing Arabic text (Appendix A). (1) Height reference: the Arabic says natural ground level before grading and filling; the English says finished ground level after grading and filling. (2) Scope: Arabic note 1 applies the limits to permanent AND temporary structures, including cranes and construction equipment; English note (1) covers permanent structures including stacks only. On the Arabic text, cranes and construction plant in Zone A are limited to 25 m above natural ground. The design, the crane/lifting plan (ADD-03 Q21) and the Section 7.3 notification should follow the Arabic text.
